title: Canthan armor
wikitext:
*'''Standard:''' Crafted by [[Kambei]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]], [[Taura]] in [[Ran Musu Gardens]], [[Tsukare]] in [[Seitung Harbor]], [[Kakumei]] in [[Kaineng Center]] and, for [[Assassins]] and [[Ritualists]], [[Jolvor Stoneforge]] in [[Boreal Station]].
*'''Prestige:''' Crafted by [[Koumei]] in [[Divine Path]].
